<X3D profile='Immersive' version='4.0' xmlns:xsd='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' xsd:noNamespaceSchemaLocation='https://www.web3d.org/specifications/x3d-4.0.xsd'>
  <head>
    <meta name='title' content='Toggle Sphere Color'/>
  </head>
  <Scene>
    <Viewpoint description='Click the sphere to toggle its color between red and green' position='0 0 5'/>

    <Transform>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material DEF='SphereMaterial' diffuseColor='1 0 0'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Sphere radius='1'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <TouchSensor DEF='ClickSensor' description='Click to toggle color'/>
    <BooleanToggle DEF='ColorToggle'/>
    <Select DEF='ColorSelector'>
      <boolInput field='boolInput'/>
      <falseValue field='falseValue'>1 0 0</falseValue>
      <trueValue field='trueValue'>0 1 0</trueValue>
      <output field='output'/>
    </Select>

    <ROUTE fromNode='ClickSensor' fromField='touchTime' toNode='ColorToggle' toField='set_bool'/>
    <ROUTE fromNode='ColorToggle' fromField='value_changed' toNode='ColorSelector' toField='boolInput'/>
    <ROUTE fromNode='ColorSelector' fromField='output' toNode='SphereMaterial' toField='diffuseColor'/>
  </Scene>
</X3D>

<X3D profile='Immersive' version='4.0' xmlns:xsd='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' xsd:noNamespaceSchemaLocation='https://www.web3d.org/specifications/x3d-4.0.xsd'>
  <Scene>
    <Viewpoint description='Interactive box' position='0 0 5'/>
    <Transform>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material DEF="boxMat" emissiveColor='0 0 0' diffuseColor='0.8 0.8 0.8' specularColor='0 0 0' shininess='0'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='2 2 2'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <TouchSensor DEF="touch"/>
    <Script DEF="highlightScript">
      <field name='isOver' type='SFBool' accessType='inputOnly'/>
      <field name='emissive' type='SFColor' accessType='outputOnly'/>
      <sourceCode><![CDATA[
        function isOver(value) {
          if (value) {
            emissive = new SFColor(1,1,0);
          } else {
            emissive = new SFColor(0,0,0);
          }
        }
      ]]></sourceCode>
    </Script>
    <ROUTE fromNode='touch' fromField='isOver' toNode='highlightScript' toField='isOver'/>
    <ROUTE fromNode='highlightScript' fromField='emissive' toNode='boxMat' toField='emissiveColor'/>
  </Scene>
</X3D>
